resources.string: Keeps Our Home running so the household can always reach this phone. It holds Our Home\'s connection to the household\'s server, so Android shows no Stop button for it. While an adult in the household looks after you (or a parent PIN is set), it also closes Our Home\'s App info, Device admin page, uninstall prompt, and this page, so Our Home can\'t be force stopped, turned off, or removed without the parent PIN. It looks at what\'s on screen only to recognise those pages. Nothing it sees is stored or sent.
Keep Our Home on this phone
Prevents Our Home from being uninstalled from this phone without the parent PIN.
